site.description: SAIN provides the community, courses and resources to help students and professionals join the AI Safety field in the Netherlands. Every programme is free.

nav.startingTeamsShort: Paid starting teams wanted in three new cities
nav.startingTeamsLong: Paid starting teams wanted in Eindhoven, Delft and The Hague

hero.title: Your AI Safety career starts here.
hero.body: AI Safety expertise has never been more important than today. SAIN provides the community, courses and resources to help students and professionals join the AI Safety field. We provide a clear path through education, community and practical projects, then connect strong contributors to the organisations, programmes and roles where they can take the next step.
hero.hiring: We are hiring paid starting teams for new chapters in Eindhoven, Delft and The Hague. Apply by {deadline}.

mission.heading: Why SAIN exists
mission.body: A free, volunteer-run path from curiosity to contribution, through courses, events, research and local chapters.

community.heading: Participate in the community
community.body: Discussion groups, hackathons, talks, and the evenings after. People meet friends and collaborators here, and often find their next step in AI Safety.
community.chapters: Our Discord community currently focuses on our SAIN Amsterdam, Utrecht and Groningen chapters.
community.nextCities: Eindhoven, Delft and The Hague are next: <link>we are hiring their starting teams</link>.

courses.body: Pick a track. Every programme is free and taught in person. What you join, and how it runs, depends on the chapter.

research.heading: The SAIN Project Hub
research.body: Bring your academic expertise to AI Safety. Connect with researchers, develop a focused project, and take your work further with support from SAIN.
research.closing: Apply any time. Determine your commitment per project. Remote participation is welcome.

careers.heading: Build an AI Safety career
careers.body: Most people who end up working on AI Safety did not plan for it. We shorten that path with mentorship, funding advice, and introductions to the labs, institutes and ministries hiring in Europe right now.
careers.quote: Without this community I almost certainly wouldn’t be where I am.
careers.quoteProject: Mapping research on AI alignment techniques and government interventions

involved.heading: The next decade is being decided now
involved.body: You do not need a background in AI to be useful here. Every SAIN programme is free, run by volunteers, and takes you from curious to contributing, so pick one and begin.

landing.heroChartAlt: An accelerating AI trajectory starts at the origin. Two people learn and practise while a third points up at the turning point, where the curve forks into a steep orange path and a gentler grey one.
landing.missionStatement: <muted>Too few people know how to work on AI safety, in research, in policy, or in public debate.</muted> SAIN <verb>trains</verb> more of them, <verb>connects</verb> them, and gets them <verb>started</verb>.

matching.title: Supervised matching
matching.description: Connect with PhD+ supervisors for structured, mentored AI Safety research.

compute.title: Compute & support
compute.description: Access compute and logistical support for your project or open collaboration.

network.title: National network
network.description: Work with researchers, advisors, and practitioners across SAIN’s Dutch chapters.

publication.title: Publication track
publication.description: Build your research track record in a community with work at NeurIPS, ICLR, and other leading venues.

project.title: Choose a research project
project.body: Join a project or bring your own question. Put your academic expertise to work on AI Safety, with the people and resources to take it further.

support.title: Work with support
support.body: SAIN helps coordinate research and arrange compute according to project needs. Develop your work with supervisor feedback or independent collaborators.

publish.title: Publish your findings
publish.body: Turn your findings into a paper, policy brief, or research tool. Get feedback on drafts, with potential support for conference travel.
